description:
Search Ukrainian legislation by free text and/or metadata filters.

One entry per matching document, carrying the `nreg` `get_document_toc` takes.
Never text.

`in_force_on_date` keeps only acts the portal's own commencement and repeal
events put in force that day, dropping any act with no such event recorded.
`total` counts what it kept; `total_relation: 'gte'` marks a floor.

in_scope.description: Only legislation the corpus treats as in scope.

name: ua_law__search
title: Search Ukrainian Legislation
